state.lastRunNotes: Broad altseason rally on Fed/BoJ macro shifts and Greed-71 sentiment; held BTC/SOL/XLM core theses intact (SOL's Alpenglow upgrade still pending in October). Added three swing positions on confirmed catalysts rather than chasing the biggest movers blind: UNI and BCH both on CME Group's Sept 22 announcement to list regulated futures Oct 19 (first DEX token on a regulated futures rail), and AVAX on its Sept 22 Helicon upgrade plus Aave V4's RWA Hub expanding onto the chain. Sized modestly (~5% NAV each) since all three had already run 20-115% intraday on the news. Growth/core (ex-daytrade) moves to roughly 45%/55%, within band; skipped day-trades since these are multi-week theses, not same-day setups.

trades.horizon: Reassess at next FOMC meeting or if weekly ETF flows turn net-negative for 2 consecutive weeks
trades.rationale: US spot BTC ETFs took in $3.52B in August with only 5/21 sessions seeing outflows; over $648M in short positions unwound as price broke above $85k, and BTC is on a rare three-month winning streak. Establishing core position on this institutional-flow catalyst despite today's intraday pullback on rising bond yields.
trades.sentimentSummary: Bullish institutional flow narrative, but short-term choppy as yields rise; mixed but net positive.

trades.horizon: Reassess ahead of the Alpenglow Consensus Upgrade in October 2026
trades.rationale: Five spot SOL ETFs have drawn $1.12B cumulative inflows with institutional accumulation (Goldman Sachs, Electric Capital) absorbing retail profit-taking; Alpenglow consensus upgrade targeting ~150ms finality is scheduled for October 2026 as a forward catalyst. Sized as growth-sleeve position given higher volatility.
trades.sentimentSummary: Strong institutional accumulation narrative with a concrete upcoming technical catalyst.

trades.horizon: Reassess by mid-October once post-upgrade adoption/throughput metrics are clearer
trades.rationale: Stellar's Protocol 28 ('Adapter') upgrade activated on mainnet Sept 17, 2026, improving consensus resilience and enabling atomic smart-contract fleet upgrades, driving a direct price catalyst and record throughput. Established core position to capture continued adoption momentum.
trades.sentimentSummary: Positive technical catalyst confirmed live on mainnet, early-stage adoption story.

trades.horizon: Reassess at Oct 19 CME UNI futures launch, or sooner if regulatory review stalls
